thread:
alice: Quick check — onboarding llama3-7b-qlora on staging. Seeing Triton kernel mismatch errors when seq_len hits ~2048. Anyone seen this before?

ben: I saw similar last week w/ cuda 12.3+ drivers causing fallback. Where are the weights for this run so I can reproduce locally?

alice: weights are in s3://redwood-models/llama3/llama3-7b/qlora/v1/ (manifest sha256 pinned). Note: tokenizer is HF facebook/llama-3-7b but we applied a tiny config patch for BOS token — might be related.

chris: Re tokenizer — I ran decode tests and found a BOS/id shift on some q4 checkpoints (id 1 vs 0). I made a tiny PR (4823) that fixes config reading for quantized tokenizer.

dani: CI container-builder failed on the triton step with: ```
Triton: CUDA error: no kernel module for compute capability 8.6
Fallback: using reference implementation (slow)
```

infra-bot: CI job container-rebuild #220 failed — https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/220 :warning:

ben: Looks like kernel selector chose a kernel that expects sm__ version not present on our node (sm86). We either force a different kernel or rebuild triton with CUTLASS patch. Quick env override I used before: `TRITON_KERNEL_SELECTOR=compat_smx`

alice: Can someone rebuild the container pinned to CUDA 12.2 libs? Staging nodes are on 525.x drivers. If the dedicated pool has 535.x that could explain driver mismatch.

sre-latency: Confirming staging nodes are driver 525.85 (CUDA 12.2 supported). Dedicated prod fleet currently on driver 535.XX (we upgraded last month). That mismatch explains why triton tries fallback on certain GPUs.

chris: I'll kick a rebuild with CUDA 12.2. Build args I'm planning: 
```
docker build \n  --build-arg CUDA_VERSION=12.2 \n  --build-arg CUDNN_VERSION=8.9 \n  -t rr/llama3:qlora-12.2 .
```
I'll run triton unit tests after build.

dani: Note: when kernel fallback happens perf drops ~3-4x (seen on microbench). Also re tokenizer: run this quick check: `python eval_tokenizer.py --model s3://... --check-bos` — it prints mismatched ids.

ben: Fast unblock option: pin staging to a previous Triton image (triton:23.06) to validate weights & tokenizer independently while the container rebuild runs.

alice: Plan: chris triggers CUDA 12.2 build; ben validates tokenizer/weights; dani runs perf bench on the rebuilt image; I'll coordinate PR to pin kernel selector fallback and update model-catalog if all green. :thumbsup: 

infra-bot: Triggered build rr/llama3:qlora-12.2 (#221) — queued (https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/221)

chris: Started CI unit tests for rr/llama3:qlora-12.2 — ETA ~18m

ben: Heads up — weights manifest requires requester flag for S3 pulls in some accounts. Use `aws s3 cp --request-payer requester s3://...` if you get 403s. Also preserve sha256 check.

alice: If CI passes, we'll mark model as 'ready' in model-catalog under `llama3/qlora/v1` and schedule a canary on the dedicated pool tomorrow morning.

chris: CI unit tests passed, image pushed as rr/llama3:qlora-12.2. Running quick perf bench on staging now.

dani: Perf bench looks good — no fallback, token throughput restored to expected baseline. Will run a 1h canary.

alice: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll merge PR 4823 for the tokenizer patch and update the onboarding checklist to include CUDA/Triton matrix notes.

ben: Leaving a quick note in the model-catalog entry about driver compatibility and container tag.

chris: Done. Image tag + notes in model-catalog. Closing loop here.
